title: Rav Chana bar Yehudah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Berakhot 48a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.48a.10), speaking in Rava’s name; Hyman reports the Dikdukei Soferim reading R"H bar Yehudah.[^1]

notes.text: The attribution begins at the end of 48a and the ruling continues on [48b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.48b.1). [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1381&lang=en) cites both sides of the folio. The Dikdukei Soferim form ר״ה is as Hyman reports it.
